observed: In the install result (sampled 2s after the uninstaller returned), HKCU\Software\gz ers\OpenCodeX Desktop still existed. A later read-only post-check found it absent.
explanation: The NSIS uninstaller copies itself to %TEMP% and returns before its final registry cleanup finishes. The key was therefore a transient state at the 2s sample, not a permanent residual. No cleanup action was taken by the post-check; the key disappeared on its own.
note: nsis/result.json is left unmodified as the original record; this file is the correction.
